=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/consumer_health_check.py:101-107 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The poller-silence check uses `created_at` rather than the run start time (`run_started_at`), although the stated condition is that the poller "started" no run in the window.
  WHY: A queued run with a fresh `created_at` hides a silent poller, and a run created long ago that started recently is reported silent. Severity is MAJOR from three reviewers. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 looked at the same code and judged it a nit at best (confidence 2), but did not report it as a finding.
- scripts/consumer_health_check.sh:249-258 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram WARNING for a failed workflow enable is sent only when `write_failures` is 0, so a persistent issue create/close failure suppresses it and the script exits 1.
  WHY: The daily cache is saved only after a successful run, so every poll tick repeats the ~41 reads and the operator is never alerted. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it NIT, and the others rated it MAJOR (highest used).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Both scripts are staged from `.codex-workflow-src`, falling back to `.codex-workflow-src-main`."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, "Run daily consumer health check" staging block (lines 1556-1562)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The block uses only `.codex-workflow-src` and exits if the scripts are missing, and `.codex-workflow-src-main` is removed earlier at line 795, so the fallback can never be used. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER from google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, MAJOR from openai_gpt-6-luna, and NIT from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, who calls it a description mismatch where the PR description should drop the fallback wording. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash made the same observation but did not report it as a gap.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/consumer_health_check.sh:251-258 (with .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml lines 1541-1542, 1571) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A persistently failing issue create or close leaves the day unrecorded and raises only a `::warning::` in the log. No Telegram message goes out, and the failed-enable warning is held back too.
  WHY: The cache entry is saved only after a successful run, so every `*/5` poll tick repeats the whole check (about 41 reads) and the operator learns nothing.
- (Considered `created_at` at scripts/consumer_health_check.py:101-107 and chose not to report it: a nit at best, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE 2.)
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Both scripts are staged from `.codex-workflow-src`, falling back to `.codex-workflow-src-main`."
  Expected change site: the "Run daily consumer health check" block in `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`.
  Evidence of absence: The block uses only `.codex-workflow-src`. The step's own comment says "Stage workflow support files" removes `.codex-workflow-src-main` earlier in the job. This is a description mismatch, not a code gap.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/consumer_health_check.py:104-106 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The poller-silent check relies on `created_at` rather than `started_at` or status.
  WHY: A queued run has a past `created_at`, which can cause false negatives or false positives about silence.
- scripts/consumer_health_check.sh:251-255 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Telegram warnings for workflow enables are suppressed if any other issue write failure occurs in the same run.
  WHY: `write_failures` is incremented on an issue create or close failure, which skips the enable warnings and delays operator intervention.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Both scripts are staged from .codex-workflow-src, falling back to .codex-workflow-src-main."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, the "Run daily consumer health check" staging block
  Evidence of absence: Lines 1556-1562 set src to `.codex-workflow-src` and exit if the scripts are missing, never trying `.codex-workflow-src-main`, which is removed at line 795.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/consumer_health_check.sh:249-258 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Telegram WARNING for failed workflow enables is gated on `[ "${write_failures}" -eq 0 ]`, so an unrelated issue create/close failure leaves the queued enable messages unsent and the script exits 1 at line 258.
  WHY: The alert depends on the success of unrelated writes, so a window where any such write fails silently swallows the enable alert.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/consumer_health_check.py:101-107 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The poller-silence check evaluates `created_at` but reports whether the latest run "started" recently.
  WHY: A queued run with a recent `created_at` suppresses `poller_silent`, and an older run that started recently can be reported silent.
- scripts/consumer_health_check.sh:251-258 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A failed workflow-enable warning is sent only when `write_failures` is zero.
  WHY: With an unrelated issue write also failing, the warning is suppressed and the script exits unsuccessfully. The daily cache is saved only after a successful run, so later ticks retry and suppress it again.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Both scripts are staged from `.codex-workflow-src`, falling back to `.codex-workflow-src-main`."
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, "Run daily consumer health check" staging block.
  Evidence of absence: Lines 1556-1562 use only `.codex-workflow-src` and exit if either script is missing. `.codex-workflow-src-main` is removed at line 795.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/consumer_health_check.py:102 (feeding the `poller_silent` decision at lines 106-110) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The silence check measures when a run was created (`created_at`), not when it started. `scripts/build_state_snapshot.py:356` already prefers `run_started_at`.
  WHY: Runs that stay `queued` keep `created_at` fresh while the poller does no work, so `poller_silent` never fires. A run created long ago that started recently is reported silent.
- scripts/consumer_health_check.sh:249-255 (enable handling at lines 176-181) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The enable-failure WARNING is delivered only on a run where `write_failures == 0`, and the `::warning::` at line 257 appears only in the run log.
  WHY: With a persistent issue-write failure, every tick retries about 41 API reads, exits 1, and sends no Telegram message. This violates the agents.md "Telegram alert levels" convention of a once-per-condition stuck alert.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): (1) scripts/consumer_health_check.py lines 100-110: prefer `run_started_at` and fall back to `created_at`, about 1 line. (2) scripts/consumer_health_check.sh lines 176-181 and 249-255: send each enable-failure WARNING on first occurrence per (repo, workflow) per day regardless of `write_failures`, about 5 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
- Not reported as a gap: the PR description's fallback wording is stale, since `.codex-workflow-src-main` is removed at orchestrate_poll.yml:795, and the committed docs do not claim the fallback.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
